# 1 Enoch Chapter 54 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**54:1** And I looked and turned to another part of the earth, and there I saw a deep valley with burning fire.

**54:2** And they brought the kings and the mighty and began to cast them into that deep valley.

**54:3** And there my eyes saw how iron chains of immeasurable weight were being made for them.

**54:4** And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: "For whom are these chains being prepared?"

**54:5** And he said to me: "These are being prepared for the hosts of Azazel, so that they may be taken and cast into the abyss of complete condemnation, and their jaws shall be covered with rough stones, as the Lord of Spirits commanded."

**54:6** "And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that the Lord of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subjects of Satan and in leading astray those who dwell on the earth."

**54:7** "And in those days punishment shall come from the Lord of Spirits, and he will open all the chambers of waters which are above the heavens, and of the fountains which are beneath the earth."

**54:8** "And all the waters shall be joined with the waters: that which is above the heavens is the masculine, and the water which is beneath the earth is the feminine."

**54:9** "And they shall destroy all who dwell on the earth and those who dwell under the ends of the heavens."

**54:10** "And when they have acknowledged their unrighteousness which they have committed on the earth, then by these shall they perish."

---

*LOGOS notes: The punishment of Azazel's hosts (vv. 1–6) parallels ch. 10 and provides the fate of the fallen angels. The four archangels (Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Phanuel) execute judgment together — completing the cosmic judicial role first described in ch. 40. The second flood (vv. 7–10) is not Noah's flood but a future judgment-flood, using the same cosmic waters.*
